turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We don’t currently ship internationally outside of the United States and select regions in Canada.

Here’s how it breaks down:

United States (contiguous U.S., plus limited items to Alaska & Hawaii):

No customs or duties, just normal shipping.

Canada (limited regions, select items only):

We do ship some roses to eligible Canadian regions on a seasonal basis (typically March through August).
Canadian prices are shown in CAD and already include all duties and taxes in the listed price, so you won’t get a separate customs bill; it’s built into what you pay at checkout.

We don’t ship to any other countries or to US territories right now. If you tell me what country you’re in, I can confirm what’s possible for your location specifically.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping is pretty quick, but it works a bit differently from a typical “order today, ship tomorrow” setup because you choose your timeframe.

Here’s how it works:

In the United States:

At checkout, you pick an estimated delivery date that works for you.
Once your order ships, carrier transit time is typically 1–5 business days, depending on how far you are from our Oregon nurseries.
We only use standard ground shipping; we don’t offer express or same-day shipping.

In Canada (eligible regions, select items):

You choose a ship week at checkout instead of a specific day.
Orders go out that week, then typically arrive the following week, depending on customs and carrier timing.

All dates are estimates, since weather and carrier delays can affect timing. If you tell me your country (and state or province), I can give you a more tailored expectation for your area.
